_note: Textures des plateaux de combat, communes à tous les mondes. Une ambiance = trois textures vues de dessus (sol, terrain difficile, dessus de mur). Le moteur choisit l'ambiance d'une rencontre (champ `terrain`). Les `reliefs` sont des plaques (eau, boue, neige) posées sur les cases de n'importe quelle ambiance ; les arbres et les rochers sont dessinés en vecteur par le jeu.

foret.sol: a forest road and clearing floor: packed earth, short grass tufts, scattered fallen leaves and small pebbles
foret.difficile: dense forest undergrowth: thick ferns, brambles, tangled roots and low thorny bushes
foret.mur: the tops of large old tree trunks and boulders seen from above, mossy bark and grey rock

souterrain.sol: an ancient crypt floor of worn square grey flagstones with thin cracks, dust and a few scattered bone fragments
souterrain.difficile: collapsed crypt rubble: broken flagstones, heaped stone debris, shattered urns and bones
souterrain.mur: the top of a thick dungeon wall of large dark grey stone blocks, seen from above

caverne.sol: a cave floor of uneven brown rock, damp patches, gravel and small puddles
caverne.difficile: a cave floor strewn with loose scree, sharp stalagmite stumps and slippery wet stones
caverne.mur: rough solid cave rock seen from above, dark brown and grey, natural rock formations

camp.sol: a military camp ground of trampled muddy earth and dry straw, cart ruts and boot prints
camp.difficile: deep churned mud with puddles, broken crates and scattered straw
camp.mur: a palisade of sharpened wooden stakes and stacked crates seen from above

neige.sol: a snowy mountain pass floor: packed white snow with faint footprints, patches of frozen grey earth and scattered small stones
neige.difficile: deep snow drifts: soft heaped powder snow in uneven mounds with pale blue shadows
neige.mur: the top of rocky cliffs and jagged boulders dusted with snow, seen from above, dark grey stone with white snow caps

reliefs.eau: shallow clear water over a pebbly river bed seen from above: gentle ripples, translucent teal-blue, pebbles and sand visible beneath, no shoreline, no foam
reliefs.boue: wet churned mud: dark brown glossy mud with puddle reflections, boot prints and sticky ruts
reliefs.neige: freshly fallen deep snow: smooth white powder with soft blue-grey shadow hollows and a few sparkles
